args.name: expression
args.description: pcap-filter(7) expression selecting which packets to dump

suggestions.name: host
suggestions.description: Match packets to or from the given host

suggestions.name: net
suggestions.description: Match packets to or from the given network (format: "net/len" or "net mask netmask")

suggestions.name: port
suggestions.description: Match packets to or from the given port

suggestions.name: portrange
suggestions.description: Match packets to or from the given port range (format: "port1-port2")

suggestions.name: src
suggestions.description: Restrict the following primitive to the source address

suggestions.name: dst
suggestions.description: Restrict the following primitive to the destination address

suggestions.name: ether
suggestions.description: Restrict the following primitive to link-level addresses

suggestions.name: proto
suggestions.description: Restrict the following primitive to a protocol number or name

suggestions.name: tcp
suggestions.description: Match TCP packets

suggestions.name: udp
suggestions.description: Match UDP packets

suggestions.name: icmp
suggestions.description: Match ICMP packets

suggestions.name: arp
suggestions.description: Match ARP packets

suggestions.name: ip
suggestions.description: Match IPv4 packets

suggestions.name: ip6
suggestions.description: Match IPv6 packets

suggestions.name: vlan
suggestions.description: Match 802.1Q VLAN packets, optionally with the given VLAN ID

suggestions.name: and
suggestions.description: Combine the surrounding primitives with a logical AND

suggestions.name: or
suggestions.description: Combine the surrounding primitives with a logical OR

suggestions.name: not
suggestions.description: Negate the following primitive

options.name: -A
options.description: Print each packet in ASCII

options.name: -b
options.description: Print the AS number in BGP packets in ASDOT notation

name: -B
--buffer-size
options.description: Set the operating system capture buffer size

options.name: -c
options.description: Exit after receiving count packets

options.name: --count
options.description: Print only the packet count when reading capture files

options.name: -C
options.description: Start a new savefile once the current one exceeds this size

options.name: -d
options.description: Dump the compiled packet-matching code in a human readable form

options.name: -dd
options.description: Dump the compiled packet-matching code as a C program fragment

options.name: -ddd
options.description: Dump the compiled packet-matching code as decimal numbers

name: -D
--list-interfaces
options.description: Print the list of network interfaces available on the system

options.name: -e
options.description: Print the link-level header on each dump line

options.name: -E
options.description: Set the options for decrypting IPsec ESP packets

options.name: -f
options.description: Print foreign IPv4 addresses numerically

options.name: -F
options.description: Use file as input for the filter expression

options.name: -G
options.description: Rotate the savefile given with -w every rotate_seconds seconds

name: -h
--help
options.description: Print the version strings and a usage message

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the tcpdump and libpcap version strings

options.name: -H
options.description: Attempt to detect 802.11s draft mesh headers

name: -i
--interface
options.description: Listen on the given interface

args.name: interface
args.description: Interface name, "any" to capture on all of them, or the number reported by -D

name: -I
--monitor-mode
options.description: Put the interface in monitor mode (802.11 only)

options.name: --immediate-mode
options.description: Capture in immediate mode, delivering packets as they arrive

name: -j
--time-stamp-type
options.description: Set the time stamp type for the capture

args.name: tstamp_type
args.description: One of the types listed by -J for the interface

suggestions.name: host
suggestions.description: Time stamp supplied by the host

suggestions.name: host_lowprec
suggestions.description: Low-precision host time stamp

suggestions.name: host_hiprec
suggestions.description: High-precision host time stamp

suggestions.name: adapter
suggestions.description: High-precision adapter time stamp, synced to the host

suggestions.name: adapter_unsynced
suggestions.description: High-precision adapter time stamp, not synced to the host

name: -J
--list-time-stamp-types
options.description: List the time stamp types supported by the interface

options.name: --time-stamp-precision
options.description: Set the time stamp precision for the capture

suggestions.name: micro
suggestions.description: Microsecond precision

suggestions.name: nano
suggestions.description: Nanosecond precision

options.name: --micro
options.description: Shorthand for --time-stamp-precision=micro

options.name: --nano
options.description: Shorthand for --time-stamp-precision=nano

name: -K
--dont-verify-checksums
options.description: Do not attempt to verify IP, TCP, or UDP checksums

options.name: -l
options.description: Make stdout line buffered

name: -L
--list-data-link-types
options.description: List the data link types supported by the interface

options.name: -m
options.description: Load SMI MIB module definitions from file

options.name: -M
options.description: Use a shared secret for validating the digests of TCP-MD5 options

options.name: -n
options.description: Do not convert host addresses to names

options.name: -nn
options.description: Do not convert protocol and port numbers to names either

options.name: -N
options.description: Do not print the domain name qualification of host names

name: --number
options.description: Print an optional packet number at the beginning of the line

name: -O
--no-optimize
options.description: Do not run the packet-matching code optimizer

name: -p
--no-promiscuous-mode
options.description: Do not put the interface into promiscuous mode

options.name: --print
options.description: Print parsed packet output even when writing packets with -w

name: -Q
--direction
options.description: Choose the direction for which packets should be captured

suggestions.name: in
suggestions.description: Capture only incoming packets

suggestions.name: out
suggestions.description: Capture only outgoing packets

suggestions.name: inout
suggestions.description: Capture packets in both directions (the default)

options.name: -q
options.description: Print less protocol information, so output lines are shorter

options.name: -r
options.description: Read packets from file

args.name: file
args.description: Savefile written with -w, or "-" for standard input

name: -S
--absolute-tcp-sequence-numbers
options.description: Print absolute, rather than relative, TCP sequence numbers

name: -s
--snapshot-length
options.description: Snarf snaplen bytes of data from each packet

args.name: snaplen
args.description: Bytes to capture per packet; 0 means the default of 262144

options.name: -T
options.description: Force packets selected by the expression to be interpreted as the given type

options.name: -t
options.description: Do not print a timestamp on each dump line

options.name: -tt
options.description: Print the timestamp as seconds since the epoch on each dump line

options.name: -ttt
options.description: Print a delta between the current and the previous line

options.name: -tttt
options.description: Print the timestamp as a time of day preceded by the date

options.name: -ttttt
options.description: Print a delta between the current and the first line

options.name: -u
options.description: Print undecoded NFS handles

name: -U
--packet-buffered
options.description: Write each packet to the savefile as it is captured

options.name: -v
options.description: Produce (slightly more) verbose output

options.name: -vv
options.description: Produce more verbose output than -v

options.name: -vvv
options.description: Produce more verbose output than -vv

options.name: -V
options.description: Read a list of savefile names from file

options.name: -w
options.description: Write the raw packets to file rather than printing them

args.name: file
args.description: Savefile to create, or "-" for standard output

options.name: -W
options.description: Limit the number of files created by -C or -G

options.name: -x
options.description: Print the data of each packet in hex, without its link level header

options.name: -xx
options.description: Print the data of each packet in hex, including its link level header

options.name: -X
options.description: Print the data of each packet in hex and ASCII, without its link level header

options.name: -XX
options.description: Print the data of each packet in hex and ASCII, including its link level header

name: -y
--linktype
options.description: Set the data link type to use while capturing packets

args.name: datalinktype
args.description: One of the types listed by -L for the interface, such as "EN10MB"

options.name: -z
options.description: Run "command file" after each savefile rotation

name: -Z
--relinquish-privileges
options.description: Drop privileges to the given user before opening any savefiles
